listing.name: Killzone — KillzoneRecomp (drakolordx7)
listing.summary: This project recompiles EE game code with emulator-derived device libraries. A latest-build download is linked, but the README’s player-feature claims have not been confirmed by Portcove. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SCUS-97402 ISO. The exact revision and hash are unknown here; check upstream before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README’s latest-build link to extract the native Windows package and launch killzone.exe with your own SCUS97402 disc. A source build separately requires Visual Studio, CMake, Ninja, Python and emulator-derived dependencies.

warnings: This project recompiles EE game code with emulator-derived device libraries. A latest-build download is linked, but the README’s player-feature claims have not been confirmed by Portcove.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
